name: glory-dump
description: GLORY/DUMP: a Solana reverse-wealth PvP strategy game

scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && cargo check -p glory_dump --features idl-build
scripts.check:frontend: tsc --noEmit && vitest run && vite build --config vite.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run check:rust && pnpm run check:frontend && pnpm run check:scripts
scripts.idl: anchor idl build -p glory_dump -o frontend/src/idl/glory_dump.json -t frontend/src/idl/glory_dump.ts

author: Prime Anomaly
